name: Connections Care Management
desc: Care management practice led by licensed clinical social workers. Assessments and care plans, going to medical appointments, overseeing home care, help choosing senior housing, benefit applications and crisis help. Offices in Montclair, NJ and Suffern, NY.
creds: Lisa Kolton, LCSW, C-ASWCM and Kimberly Hamilton, LCSW, C-ASWCM

name: Connie Rosenberg & Associates Care Management
desc: An Aging Life Care management firm in Northern New Jersey that has served older adults and adults with disabilities since 1987, with offices in Morris Plains and Westfield. It helps with care planning, memory care and planning ahead, and works with families and professionals.
creds: Michelle L. Summer, MSW, CMC (listed by the Aging Life Care Association)

name: Unicity Care Management
desc: Nurses and social workers assess an older adult's health, memory, daily living needs, home safety and finances, then build a care plan. They can coordinate in-home care, hospital discharge and moves to assisted living or memory care, and provide ongoing oversight.

name: The Senior Company (Mint Care Management)
desc: Geriatric care managers help seniors and their families with provider coordination, follow up on medical appointments, family updates, insurance and veterans benefits, and finding assisted living or skilled nursing when needed.

name: NightingaleNJ Eldercare Navigators
desc: A Central Jersey eldercare practice offering life management planning, help with transitions and housing changes, and memory care coordination. Advocacy services include going to medical appointments, home safety assessments, medication review and on call crisis support.

name: Springpoint at Home
desc: Senior care management that helps older adults stay safely at home and supports family caregivers, including medical appointment coordination, housing and benefit planning and referrals. In Mercer, Middlesex, Monmouth and Somerset counties it also offers in-home care.
creds: Annette Murphy, MSW, LSW, C-ASWCM

name: Aging Advisors
desc: A care management practice based in Pennington that works with older adults, solo agers and their families on planning and coordinating care.
creds: Soni Pahade, MS Gerontology, CMC (listed by the Aging Life Care Association)

name: Meraki Care Management
desc: A care management practice in Hazlet serving Monmouth County, run by a registered nurse who is a member of the Aging Life Care Association.
creds: Elizabeth Toal, RN

name: Lotus Elder Care & Counseling
desc: Elder care management and counseling for families with aging relatives and people planning to age well in southern New Jersey, including Cherry Hill, Moorestown and Haddonfield. Services include care plans, crisis help, memory loss support, LGBTQ+ aging support and psychotherapy.
creds: Linda B. Goldberg, MSW, LCSW, CDP

name: South Jersey Geriatric Care
desc: Geriatric care management and mental health counseling for seniors and their caregivers, with offices in Cherry Hill and Somers Point. Help includes home consultations, care planning, going to appointments, home safety checks and caregiver support groups.
creds: Lori Heberley, MA, LPC, CMC (listed by the Aging Life Care Association)

name: LifeSpan Care Management
desc: Care management and patient advocacy for older adults and people with chronic illness in South Jersey and the Delaware Valley. Services include care plans, aging in place planning, help after a hospital stay and advocacy in hospitals and care facilities.

name: Jewish Family Service of MetroWest New Jersey
desc: Older adult services include free case management for adults 65 and up, care consultation for family caregivers, fee based geriatric assessments, counseling, caregiver respite, friendly visiting and Medicare counseling. Offices are in Florham Park and West Orange.

name: Jewish Family & Children's Services of Northern New Jersey
desc: Care management, private care management, kosher Meals on Wheels, friendly visitors and telephone reassurance for older adults, plus programs for Holocaust survivors. Offices are in Teaneck and Wayne.

name: Jewish Family Service (Clifton and Passaic)
desc: Senior services include in-home counseling for homebound older adults, caregiver support, the Sequoia Wellness Center social day program for adults 60 and up, educational talks and help for Holocaust survivors.

name: Jewish Family Services of Central New Jersey
desc: Serves Union and parts of Somerset County with a home health aide and homemaker program, kosher Meals on Wheels, rides to medical appointments for lower income seniors in Union County, counseling and a memory loss program.

name: Jewish Family Services of Middlesex County
desc: Senior services include kosher Meals on Wheels across Middlesex County, Medicare counseling through SHIP, congregate kosher lunches and case management and home help for Holocaust survivors. Offices are in North Brunswick and Monroe Township.

name: Jewish Family Service of Somerset, Hunterdon and Warren Counties
desc: Licensed geriatric social workers offer in-home counseling, case management, geriatric assessments and caregiver support. Volunteer programs include a senior friendly visitor and a senior shopper service.

name: Jewish Family & Children's Service of Greater Mercer County
desc: Older adult services include geriatric care management, the Secure@Home membership program, a free Mercer County caregiver support helpline, friendly callers and visitors, and senior nutrition programs.

name: Jewish Family & Children's Service of Monmouth County
desc: A social service agency with offices in Asbury Park and Morganville. Its programs include geriatric counseling, senior socialization, a home health aide program and kosher Meals on Wheels.

name: Jewish Family and Children's Service of Southern New Jersey
desc: Older Adult Services help people live independently as they age, with in-home services, counseling, transportation, support groups and consultations to plan for future needs or a move.

name: Catholic Charities of the Archdiocese of Newark, Adult Services
desc: Programs for older adults include counseling for caregivers, free mental health counseling for Union County residents 60 and up, telephone reassurance, grocery shopping for homebound seniors and help for Hispanic older adults finding services.

name: NewBridge Services, Senior Assistance for Independent Living (SAIL)
desc: A free program for Morris County residents 60 and older who want to keep living at home. It starts with an in-home assessment and ongoing case management and can arrange meals, rides, aide care, home repairs and counseling. Referrals come through the Morris County Office of Aging.

name: Bergen Family Center
desc: A Bergen County nonprofit with senior services that include case management, counseling for seniors and SESCIL, a program of lifelong learning and social time for older adults.

name: Senior Citizens United Community Services (SCUCS)
desc: A nonprofit serving Camden County seniors, with services that include personal care at home, respite, caregiver education, home delivered meals and housing counseling.

name: SAGE Eldercare Home Care
desc: A nonprofit that provides home care along with meals delivery, social work support, Medicare counseling and medical alert service for seniors in Union, Essex, Morris and Somerset counties.

name: Valley Home Care
desc: The home care service of Valley Health System, offering skilled nursing, home health aides, social services and medication help.

name: VNA Health Group, Private Care
desc: A long established visiting nurse organization. Its private care offers nursing and certified home health aides, hourly or live-in, to help with bathing, dressing, meals and light housekeeping.

name: Hunterdon Health Home Health Services
desc: A nonprofit home health agency of Hunterdon Health serving Hunterdon County only, with nurses, therapists, medical social workers and home health aides. The site says it is licensed by the New Jersey Department of Health.

name: Home Instead (Teaneck)
desc: An independently owned Home Instead office providing in-home senior care in Bergen County towns, including companionship, memory care, respite and 24 hour care.

name: Home Instead (Millburn)
desc: An independently owned Home Instead office serving towns in Essex and Union counties such as Montclair, Livingston, Summit and Westfield, with help at home, dementia care, respite and post hospital support.

name: Home Instead (Somerset)

name: Home Instead (Shrewsbury)

name: Home Instead (Sewell)

name: Caring Senior Service (Morristown area)
desc: Provides in-home support for older adults in the Morristown area, including companion, personal, dementia and respite care and help after a hospital stay.

name: Visiting Angels (Toms River and Brick)
desc: An independently owned Visiting Angels office serving Ocean County, with a focus on the Toms River and Brick area. Caregivers help with daily routines, safety, meals and companionship.

name: Comfort Keepers (Cherry Hill)
desc: RN supervised in-home care for seniors and adults with disabilities in Camden and Burlington counties, from a few hours a week to 24 hour and live-in care, including dementia and respite care.

name: Right at Home (Atlantic County)
desc: In-home care for seniors in Atlantic, Cape May, Cumberland and Salem counties, from companionship and household help to around the clock care.

name: SAGE Spend-A-Day Medical Adult Day Care
desc: A medical adult day program open weekdays from 9:00 a.m. to 3:30 p.m. with nursing care, meals, therapy, social work and activities. Transportation help is offered for Union County residents.

name: Belleville Senior Health Services
desc: Adult medical day care with door-to-door transportation, meals, daily programs and medical and nursing support, open weekdays. The center says services are covered by Medicaid Managed Care plans.

name: 2nd Home Perth Amboy
desc: An adult medical day care center run by 2nd Home, which operates several adult day locations in North and Central Jersey.

name: 2nd Home Union City
desc: An adult medical day care center run by 2nd Home, which operates several adult day locations in North and Central Jersey.

name: 2nd Home Paterson
desc: An adult medical day care center run by 2nd Home, which operates several adult day locations in North and Central Jersey.

name: Active Day of Cape May
desc: An adult day program listed by the New Jersey Division of Aging Services as a provider in the state's Alzheimer's Adult Day Services Program. Call the center to ask about its schedule, services and costs.

name: Carative LLC
desc: A geriatric care management practice whose nurses do geriatric assessments, coordinate medical care and help with hospital discharge planning. They also offer move management, weekly medication box setup and arranged driving evaluations.

name: Sabin Elder Care Solutions
desc: A private geriatric care management practice founded in 2013, with a team from social work and nursing backgrounds. Services include crisis management, assessment, caregiver support and advocacy.
creds: Wendy Sabin, MSW, LCSW

name: LMR Elder Care
desc: Advocacy and care coordination for older adults, adults with disabilities and family caregivers in northern New Jersey. Help includes care plans, crisis intervention, discharge planning, long term care insurance claims and informal elder care mediation.
creds: Lisa Bayer, Attorney, CCM, Certified Dementia Practitioner

name: Caring Choices
desc: A care management practice for older adults and families in northern New Jersey, serving towns including West Orange, Livingston, Morristown, Ridgewood and Bridgewater. Services include care planning, crisis prevention, memory loss support, care options and paperwork.

name: Aronsoncare
desc: An Aging Life Care practice founded more than 25 years ago, serving parts of New Jersey and New York. Services include assessments, care planning, placement, help with benefits and hospital discharge support, with experience in dementia and Parkinson's.
creds: Bonnie G. Costabile, Aging Life Care professional and physical therapist

name: Arosa North Jersey
desc: Care management, home care and private nursing from an Englewood office that has served Bergen County communities since 2003. Care managers assess needs, monitor care plans and advocate for clients.

name: Peace Care Experts
desc: Formerly Peace Aging Care Experts, founded in 2006 by a registered nurse. Its nurses, social workers and therapists provide crisis navigation, care management, long term care planning and recreation therapy.
creds: Trish Barbosa, RN-BC, CCM, LNCP-C

name: Generations Counseling & Care Management
desc: A care management and counseling agency founded in 1987 that serves older adults and people with disabilities. Services include assessments, care plans, placement help, eldercare planning and 24/7 crisis response.
creds: Vicki Sherman (Doueck), MSW, LCSW, ASWCM

name: Health Care Connect
desc: Patient advocacy and geriatric care management since 2010. Services include care plans, regular visits, medication review, coordination among doctors and help with hospital, rehab and home care decisions.
creds: Jacqueline O'Doherty, BCPA

name: Senior Care Options by Parker
desc: Aging Life Care professionals offering geriatric care management, home care assessments, counseling, Medicaid applications and placement help. They meet clients at home, in assisted living and nursing facilities and at doctor visits.

name: Elder Life Management
desc: Established in 1987, it advises older adults and families on paying for long term care, applying for government programs and moving to another living arrangement. It also helps with discharge planning after a hospital stay.

name: Arosa South Jersey
desc: Care management, home care and private nursing for families in Burlington, Camden and Gloucester counties since 2011. Care managers assess needs, monitor care plans and guide long term care decisions.

name: JFCS of Northern New Jersey, Private Care Management
desc: A fee based care management service from a nonprofit family agency with offices in Teaneck and Wayne. It starts with an at-home assessment and can include help with doctors, home safety and finances.

name: JFCS of Greater Mercer County, Geriatric Care Services
desc: Nonprofit geriatric care managers offering one-time in-home consultations and ongoing care management. Mercer County residents 60 and older may qualify for a no-cost assessment.

name: Jewish Family Services of Middlesex County, Geriatric Care Management
desc: Clinical social workers at this nonprofit agency do geriatric assessments, plan care with older adults and their families, set up services and monitor them.

name: Atlantic County Office on Aging (Area Agency on Aging)
desc: The county's Area Agency on Aging, part of the Division of Intergenerational Services. Its information line covers programs such as PAAD, Senior Gold, adult day care, transportation, home-delivered meals and caregiver support groups. Callers from outside the county can use 609-645-5965.

name: Bergen County Division of Senior Services (Area Agency on Aging)
desc: Bergen County's designated Area Agency on Aging and lead agency for the Aging and Disability Resource Connection. It helps older adults, adults with disabilities and caregivers access long-term care and community-based services.

name: Burlington County Office on Aging (Area Agency on Aging)
desc: Provides information, assistance and outreach to seniors on legal help, transportation, Meals on Wheels, home health services, respite care, adult day care and care management. It is part of the statewide ADRC.

name: Camden County Division of Aging and Disability Services (Area Agency on Aging)
desc: Supports older adults and people with disabilities with access to nutrition programs, transportation, wellness resources, safety supports and community-based help. The county site now calls it the Division of Aging and Disability Services.

name: Cape May County Department of Aging and Disability Services (Area Agency on Aging)
desc: Provides information and assistance, Meals on Wheels, congregate meals at three senior centers and the JACC in-home care program for older adults and adults with disabilities.

name: Cumberland County Office on Aging and Disabled (Area Agency on Aging)
desc: Plans and funds aging programs for residents 60 and older and adults with disabilities, including transportation, home-delivered meals, congregate lunches, outreach and Medicare counseling.

name: Essex County Division of Senior Services (Area Agency on Aging)
desc: Its ADRC Information and Assistance Unit takes applications for programs such as respite care and JACC, and connects residents to caregiver help, home-delivered meals, special transportation and health programs.

name: Gloucester County Division of Senior Services (Area Agency on Aging)
desc: The county's point of entry for help for people 60 and older, adults with physical disabilities and caregivers. Staff explain long-term care options and help people apply for programs such as MLTSS, JACC and NJ Save.

name: Hudson County Division on Aging (Area Agency on Aging)
desc: Hudson County's designated Area Agency on Aging since 1976. It plans and coordinates home and community-based services for residents 60 and older and their caregivers, and connects people to SHIP Medicare counseling.

name: Hunterdon County Division of Senior, Disabilities and Veterans' Services (Area Agency on Aging)
desc: Hunterdon County's aging office. It runs the county senior center and programs such as Mr. Fix-It, Medicare counseling, caregiver resources and the Personal Assistance Services Program.

name: Mercer County Office on Aging (Area Agency on Aging)
desc: Mercer County's Aging & Disability Resource Connection for seniors, adults with physical disabilities and family caregivers. It explains home and community-based services, Medicare and Medicaid options, housing, transportation and caregiver supports.

name: Middlesex County Office of Aging and Disabled Services (Area Agency on Aging)
desc: The state-designated area agency on aging for Middlesex County and lead ADRC agency. Information and Assistance staff screen residents for programs and help with Meals on Wheels and SHIP Medicare counseling.

name: Monmouth County Division of Aging, Disabilities and Veterans Services (Area Agency on Aging)
desc: The primary planning, coordinating and funding agency for senior programs in Monmouth County, established in 1975. Its ADRC helps older adults, caregivers and adults with disabilities access services.

name: Morris County Division on Aging, Disabilities and Community Programming (Area Agency on Aging)
desc: Provides information, referrals and direct help for older adults, people with disabilities, veterans and caregivers in Morris County.

name: Ocean County Office of Senior Services (Area Agency on Aging)
desc: The county's Area Agency on Aging and Aging & Disability Resource Connection (ADRC). It helps adults 60 and older, adults with disabilities and caregivers find and apply for local services such as meals, transportation, in-home help, caregiver support and benefits screening.

name: Passaic County Department of Senior Services, Disabilities and Veterans' Affairs (Area Agency on Aging)
desc: Coordinates services for seniors including transportation, housekeeping, home health aides, telephone reassurance, social adult day care and legal services. As the county ADRC it also offers in-home evaluations, benefit screenings and care management.

name: Salem County Office on Aging (Area Agency on Aging)
desc: Connects Salem County seniors and people with disabilities to resources. Staff help with Social Security, Medicare, Medicaid, PAAD, SHIP counseling, transportation, JACC and Adult Protective Services referrals.

name: Somerset County Office on Aging and Disability Services (Area Agency on Aging)
desc: Somerset County's Area Agency on Aging and ADRC for seniors 60 and older, adults with disabilities and caregivers. Services include benefits screening, assessments, care coordination, caregiver support and JACC.

name: Sussex County Division of Senior Services (Area Agency on Aging)
desc: Sussex County's aging office and ADRC site. It helps older adults, adults 18 and older with disabilities and caregivers choose from a coordinated system of services so they can stay independent at home.

name: Union County Division on Aging (Area Agency on Aging)
desc: One of the state's 21 Area Agencies on Aging and Union County's lead ADRC agency, giving information, referral and assistance to older adults and caregivers. Its office is at a temporary address in Westfield, and in-person visits are by appointment. Spanish: 908-527-4863.

name: Warren County Division of Aging & Disability Services (Area Agency on Aging)
desc: Warren County's lead agency for older adult services and the county ADRC. Staff do an intake and screening to identify needs and connect people to services provided directly or through partner agencies.

name: Aging in Montclair (AIM)
desc: A nonprofit membership group for adults 60 and older in Montclair and nearby towns. It runs Saturday Socials, educational programs, Conversations on Aging groups and Widows/Widowers Connection support groups, and advocates for older residents.

name: JCC MetroWest Center for Adult Enrichment
desc: Cultural, educational, recreational and social programs for adults, including Life Long Learning lectures, the Margulies Center for Adult Enrichment, kosher lunches and day trips.

name: Alzheimer's New Jersey
desc: A New Jersey nonprofit serving people affected by Alzheimer's and dementia since 1985. It offers a free, confidential helpline, caregiver education, family support groups and a respite care and wellness program.

name: Alzheimer's Association New Jersey Chapter
desc: Provides support services, care options and education for families and caregivers across New Jersey, including support groups and free education programs. Its 24/7 Helpline is free; the chapter office number is 973-437-3931.

name: Family Connections Older Adult Services
desc: Caregiver Connections offers in-home and near-home counseling, advocacy, education and care management for caregivers of older adults across Essex County. Its Older Adult Treatment Services provide in-home clinical care for older adults with depression, anxiety or substance use.

name: Jewish Federation of Greater MetroWest NJ CARES
desc: The Federation department focused on older adults. It links a network of 11 partner agencies offering caregiver support, case management, dementia programs, kosher Meals on Wheels and transportation, and keeps resource lists by county.

name: Signature Medical Daycare of Montclair
desc: An adult day health center at 110 Greenwood Avenue, founded in 1978, for people who need health monitoring, companionship or memory care. Services include transportation, breakfast and lunch, nursing, social work and activities, with counseling and support for caregivers.

name: Home Away From Home Adult Medical Day Care
desc: An adult medical day care center offering personalized care, social activities, health monitoring and wellness services. It accepts Medicaid HMOs, respite care funding and private pay.

name: JCC MetroWest Littman Family Memory Center
desc: A day program for people with mild to moderate cognitive impairment, meeting Mondays, Tuesdays and Thursdays, with socialization, exercise, music and discussion. It also gives caregivers respite and guidance.

name: Cornerstone Social Adult Day Center
desc: A nonprofit social adult day program run by Cornerstone Family Programs and partly funded by Morris County. Open weekdays 8 am to 6 pm, with sliding fee scales and transportation.

name: Atlantic Adult Day Center (Atlantic Health)
desc: A social adult day program with art, music, pet and horticultural therapy, daily exercise and lunch, plus a caregiver support group. Open weekdays 8 am to 4:30 pm; it does not provide transportation.

name: The Tender Adult Day Center
desc: A nonprofit serving people living with dementia and their caregivers since 1977. It runs a respite social day program and caregiver support groups, and helps families sort out elder care.

name: Aleph Adult Day Center
desc: An adult day program in Cherry Hill, with a second site in Northfield, for older adults with or without cognitive impairment. It offers activities, art and music therapy, light exercise, partial or full days, lunch and door-to-door transportation, with grants for those who qualify.

name: Peace Care St. Ann's Adult Medical Day Care
desc: Peace Care St. Ann's, a faith-based care community in the Greenville section of Jersey City sponsored by the Sisters of St. Joseph of Peace, runs an Adult Medical Day Care program alongside long-term care and rehabilitation.

name: Active Day of North Bergen
desc: An adult day health center at 6201 Grand Avenue with on-site medical assistance and care coordination. It runs morning and afternoon sessions on weekdays and takes part in the state Alzheimer's Adult Day Services Program.

name: Active Day of Washington Township
desc: An adult day health center open weekdays 8 am to 4:30 pm with nursing, meals, physical and occupational therapy and transportation. It takes part in the state Alzheimer's Adult Day Services Program.

name: Active Day of Camden
desc: An adult day health center at 1000 Atlantic Avenue offering full-day services with on-site medical assistance. It is listed by the state Division of Aging Services as an Alzheimer's Adult Day Services Program center.

name: Courtyard Adult Day Center
desc: A medical adult day center at Courtyard Luxury Senior Living with a nursing team, medication administration, meals, transportation, exercise and social activities. It also serves caregivers who need a break.

name: Flemington Adult Day Care Center
desc: A licensed adult day health center with an in-house registered nurse and social worker, meals, activities, help arranging doctor visits and door-to-door transportation. Open weekdays 7:30 am to 4 pm.
